body:
Founder direction: 'get it pixel for pixel parity with the windows client everything needs to work there first.' Found the browser client's actual CSS/colors had never been brought into line with docs/BRAND_STYLE_GUIDE.md at all: generic system-ui sans-serif font (guide's single most explicit rule: never a humanist sans), border-radius on every input/button/panel (guide's own named Do-Not-Do: hard rectangles only), and invented hex colors that didn't match apps/gui/main.c's Col/KIND_COL constants or fx.c's own separate C3 animation palette. Fixed for real: exact hex from main.c for all UI colors, exact hex from fx.c's own C3 constants (RED/YEL/BLU/CYAN/GRN/ORG/SIL/GRY) for animation colors -- checked by reading fx.c directly rather than assuming the static-UI palette applied to animations too -- border-radius:0 everywhere, buttons changed to borderless solid-fill blocks + inputs given a visible white 2px frame (matching the real reference screenshots docs/img/s513_desktop_menu.png and s513_desktop_match.png), Google Fonts 'Silkscreen' (a genuine blocky pixel webfont, explicitly allowed by the brand guide) as the primary font, and text-transform:uppercase on UI chrome only (scoped to exclude card names/keywords which stay natural-case on the desktop client too, confirmed in main.c). main.ts's KIND_COLORS/KIND_NAMES made byte-exact to main.c's KIND_COL/KIND_NAME arrays. Verified for real, not claimed on faith: npm run build clean; a real headless Chrome (ms-playwright's chrome-linux64, already cached in this sandbox) screenshotted the actual live page at https://wotan.okemily.com/DEADWEIGHT/ after a real redeploy (~/wotan-deploy.sh); rendered pixels sampled with ImageMagick confirmed EXACT hex matches (not just visual similarity): body bg srgb(18,20,28)=#12141C, warn border srgb(255,200,60)=#FFC83C, input border srgb(255,255,255)=#FFFFFF, button fill srgb(32,36,50)=#202432. Also confirmed applyProductionDefaults() still works correctly live post-redeploy. Real, honest, named remaining gap: this covers the setup/menu screen chrome; in-match HUD/card layout, the oversized title treatment, and per-kind ship shapes are not yet reproduced -- documented, not glossed over. Commits: DEADWEIGHT@fe8f716, DEADWEIGHT@1a54ec1, WOTAN@50afe97.

⚓ ☃
title: Real brutalist pixel-parity pass on the browser client, live-verified
